reference_sql:
WITH period_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching lines from July to December 2025
  SELECT o.store_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.store_id, ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
),
per_store AS (  -- one row per store with lines in the period
  SELECT store_id, SUM(n_lines) AS n_lines, SUM(n_lines - 1) AS n_copies
  FROM period_sets
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, ps.n_copies / NULLIF(ps.n_lines, 0) AS copy_share
FROM stores s
LEFT JOIN per_store ps ON ps.store_id = s.store_id
